Package com.bilt.pos.receipt

Class Receipts

java.lang.Object
com.bilt.pos.receipt.Receipts
public final class Receipts extends Object
Extracts and parses receipt XML payloads from a Nexo NexoTerminalAPI response.

After a payment, reversal, loyalty, or balance inquiry, the terminal returns receipts inside PaymentReceipt[] with Base64-encoded XML in OutputContent.OutputXHTML. This class locates the customer and merchant receipt entries, decodes them, and provides typed access to the receipt content.

Example usage: 


 NexoTerminalAPI response = client.request(paymentRequest);
 Receipts receipts = Receipts.fromResponse(response);

 if (receipts.hasCustomerReceipt()) {
     ReceiptType customer = receipts.customerReceipt();
     String plainText = customer.getPlainTextReceipt();
     String html = ReceiptHelper.htmlAsString(customer);
     ReceiptDataType data = customer.getReceiptData();
 }

    • fromResponse

      public static Receipts fromResponse(com.bilt.pos.nexo.model.NexoTerminalAPI response) throws jakarta.xml.bind.JAXBException
      Extracts receipts from a NexoTerminalAPI response.

      Searches for PaymentReceipt entries across payment, reversal, loyalty, and balance inquiry responses.

      Parameters:
      response - the Nexo terminal API response
      Returns:
      a Receipts instance (receipts may be absent if the response does not contain them)
      Throws:
      jakarta.xml.bind.JAXBException - if receipt XML parsing fails
      IllegalArgumentException - if the response or its SaleToPOIResponse is null
